<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="python-api">
<h1>Python API</h1>
<p>The supported Python API is the set exported from the root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ttsready</span></code> package via <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ttsready.__all__</span></code>. It is source-neutral: callers provide text and explicit language values, and TTSReady does not accept paths or format-specific document objects.</p>
<p>The public preparation surface has three levels: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_run()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_text()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_units()</span></code>.</p>
<section id="public-api-inventory">
<h2>Public API inventory</h2>
<p>The root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ttsready.__all__</span></code> is the supported API boundary. The names below are the intentional exports; a helper that is available only from an implementation submodule is not thereby a supported public API.</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Family</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Root exports</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Version</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__version__</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>JSON and input/policy models</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">JsonScalar</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">JsonValue</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticToken</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TextUnit</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProtectedSpan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationProfile</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OverrideScope</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpeechOverride</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Preparation</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_run()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_text()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_units()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apply_changes()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">split_prepared_text()</span></code></p></td>
</tr>

</tr>

</tr>

</tr>

<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TTSReadyError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MappingError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OverrideConflictError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidUnitError</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Input models describe caller-owned text, language, policy, and optional source-relative hints. Result models describe in-memory prepared output, mappings, context, QA, statistics, lexical findings, or progress observations. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">JsonScalar</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">JsonValue</span></code> identify the JSON-safe metadata value types. See the sections below and the linked guides for behavior and examples.</p>
</section>
<section id="prepare-one-string">
<h2>Prepare one string</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">prepare_text</span>

<span class="n">prepared</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_text</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Use 2 kg of flour.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">unit_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;recipe-step-1&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">role</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;body&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">unit_id</span>
<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_text</span>
<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">spoken_text</span>
<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">changes</span>
<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">issues</span>
<span class="n">prepared</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">context</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_text()</span></code> returns one <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedUnit</span></code>. Optional arguments include source-relative <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">protected_spans</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpeechOverride</span></code> values, JSON-safe caller <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">metadata</span></code>, a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationProfile</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">strict=True</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="prepare-a-compiler-owned-run">
<h2>Prepare a compiler-owned run</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_run()</span></code> is the low-level source-neutral primitive for a compiler or pipeline that already owns linguistic and sentence analysis. It returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedRun</span></code> with source/output text, changes, generic issues, language, and an exact <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SourceOutputMap</span></code>. It does not apply <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpeechOverride</span></code>, build <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnitContext</span></code>, split sentences, or create aggregate fingerprints.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">LinguisticToken</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prepare_run</span>

<span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Dr. Smith uses 2 kg.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">run</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_run</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">linguistic_tokens</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">LinguisticToken</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">text</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;Dr.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pos</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;PROPN&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">tag</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;NNP&quot;</span><span class="p">),),</span>
    <span class="n">preserve_run_boundaries</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">run</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">spoken_text</span>
<span class="n">run</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">changes</span>
<span class="n">run</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_map</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">map_source_span</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">run</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_map</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">()</span>  <span class="c1"># diagnostic representation; not result serialization</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Token offsets and optional token text refer to exactly the supplied <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>. Callers may derive hints from spaCy or another analyzer, but pass only the provider-neutral <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticToken</span></code> fields; TTSReady never accepts the provider object. When tokens are supplied, they are authoritative even if <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">profile.use_spacy=True</span></code>, while that profile option is still forwarded unchanged. TTSReady performs no second NLP pass. Consumers that need POS or morphology on normalized output must analyze <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run.spoken_text</span></code> downstream.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SourceOutputMap</span></code> preserves Spokenform’s left/right boundary biases. Left bias selects the left edge of an ambiguous replacement region; right bias selects the right edge. Span helpers use left bias for the start and right bias for the end. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SourceOutputMap.concatenate()</span></code> composes maps for independently prepared slices. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">preserve_run_boundaries=True</span></code> prevents outer run whitespace from being treated as isolated-document whitespace; it is for slices that will be concatenated, not language detection.</p>
</section>
<section id="prepare-ordered-units">
<h2>Prepare ordered units</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">TextUnit</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prepare_units</span>

<span class="n">units</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">TextUnit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter-1&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;2 kg&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">role</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;body&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">TextUnit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;caption-1&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Bonjour.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;fr-FR&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">role</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;caption&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_units</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">units</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">units</span>  <span class="c1"># ordered PreparedUnit values</span>
<span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">changes</span>  <span class="c1"># flattened source-relative changes</span>
<span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">issues</span>  <span class="c1"># flattened issues</span>
<span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">stats</span>  <span class="c1"># aggregate PreparationStats</span>
<span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">prepared_fingerprint</span>  <span class="c1"># digest of ordered prepared outputs</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Unit IDs must be unique within one result. A unit’s language is passed explicitly to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spokenform</span></code>; it is not inferred from a document. The caller controls the ID namespace and preserves any format-specific structure outside this library.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TextUnit.linguistic_tokens</span></code> accepts source-relative <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticToken</span></code> hints. It normalizes them by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(start,</span> <span class="pre">end)</span></code> and validates bounds, non-overlap, token text, and provider-neutral type. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_units()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_text()</span></code> forward supplied hints to Spokenform without asking TTSReady to load an NLP provider. Units without hints keep the original behavior and fingerprint.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare_units(...,</span> <span class="pre">on_progress=callback)</span></code> optionally reports synchronous <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationProgressEvent</span></code> values (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unit.started</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unit.completed</span></code>) with completed/total counts and unit ID, language, and role. Events are observational, are not serialized, and callback exceptions propagate. TTSReady does not print or render progress.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">PreparationProgressEvent</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">TextUnit</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prepare_units</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">report</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">PreparationProgressEvent</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kind</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">completed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">unit_id</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_units</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">TextUnit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter-1&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;2 kg&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">),),</span> <span class="n">on_progress</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">report</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="protected-spans-and-profiles">
<h2>Protected spans and profiles</h2>
<p>Protected spans are half-open offsets into the exact input string. They are not transformed, and an overlapping override is reported rather than applied:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ProtectedSpan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prepare_text</span>

<span class="n">prepared</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_text</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Use SKU-42 now.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">protected_spans</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ProtectedSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">reason</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;inventory identifier&quot;</span><span class="p">),),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationProfile</span></code> contains conservative backend and normalization options. Its defaults avoid whitespace/Unicode normalization and preserve residual sequences; number, abbreviation, and structured-value expansion remain enabled. Pass a profile explicitly when reproducibility requires a particular policy.</p>
</section>
<section id="mapping-and-context">
<h2>Mapping and context</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpokenChange</span></code> records a stable ID, unit ID, original and replacement text, source/output offsets, transformation stages, kind, and JSON-safe provenance. The offsets are half-open Python string indices. Apply a change set with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apply_changes(source_text,</span> <span class="pre">changes)</span></code>; it verifies that every source span still selects the expected source text and rejects overlapping or stale changes.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpokenChange.language</span></code> is the effective language reported by the preparation backend for that individual replacement. TTSReady preserves it exactly, even when its spelling or case differs from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedRun.language</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedUnit.language</span></code>; if the backend supplies no per-change language, the value is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code>. TTSReady does not infer or substitute a value. Use this typed field for replacement-level language; the existing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">provenance[&quot;language&quot;]</span></code> remains run/unit context and is not the per-change contract.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">prepare_run</span>

<span class="n">run</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">prepare_run</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Dr. bought 5 kg.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">change</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">run</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">changes</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">change</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedUnit</span></code> contains sentence context for both source and spoken text. For a specific change in an aggregate result, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context_for_change(result,</span> <span class="pre">change_id)</span></code> returns its unit and overlapping source/spoken sentences.</p>
</section>
<section id="text-chunking">
<h2>Text chunking</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">split_prepared_text(text,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">language,</span> <span class="pre">max_chars)</span> <span class="pre">-&gt;</span> <span class="pre">tuple[TextChunk,</span> <span class="pre">...]</span></code> chunks the string supplied by the caller; it does not prepare, normalize, or otherwise transform it. Splits prefer sentence boundaries and fall back to smaller pieces as needed to satisfy the character limit.</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Every <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TextChunk.text</span></code> is an exact slice of the original string, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">start</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">end</span></code> are source-relative half-open offsets.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">part</span></code> is zero-based; chunks concatenate back to the exact input and each chunk has at most <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">max_chars</span></code> characters.</p></li>
<li><p>Empty input returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">()</span></code>. A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">max_chars</span></code> value below 1 raises <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ValueError</span></code>.</p></li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ttsready</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">split_prepared_text</span>

<span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;First sentence. Second sentence.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">split_prepared_text</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-US&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">max_chars</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">chunks</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">source</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="public-models-and-errors">
<h2>Public models and errors</h2>
<p>Input objects include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TextUnit</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProtectedSpan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticToken</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationProfile</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OverrideScope</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpeechOverride</span></code>. Returned objects include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedRun</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparedUnit</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationResult</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpokenChange</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationIssue</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SourceOutputMap</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationStats</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TextChunk</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SentenceSpan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnitContext</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ChangeContext</span></code>. Lexical review and progress return their own result/event types, described in the <a class="reference internal" href="../lexical-review/"><span class="std std-doc">lexical review guide</span></a> and the progress section above.</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Exception</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Typical origin</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TTSReadyError</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Base for TTSReady contract and preparation failures</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationError</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>A preparation operation cannot produce a consistent result</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MappingError</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Backend source/output mappings fail verification</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OverrideConflictError</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Equally ranked overlapping overrides disagree</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidUnitError</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>A text unit or its spans violate the public contract</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationError</span></code> derives from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TTSReadyError</span></code>; the other specific preparation exceptions derive from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationError</span></code>. Raw model construction may raise ordinary <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ValueError</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TypeError</span></code>; those errors are not universally converted to TTSReady-specific exceptions.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__version__</span></code> is exported from the root package. Its SCM-derived and neutral-fallback semantics are documented under <a class="reference internal" href="../reproducibility/"><span class="std std-doc">runtime versions</span></a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="serialization">
<h2>Serialization</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationResult.to_dict()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationResult.from_dict()</span></code> provide versioned, JSON-ready serialization. The module-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_to_dict()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_from_dict()</span></code> functions are also exported. The library does not persist serialized values; choose storage and schema-retention policy in the calling application.</p>
<p>See <a class="reference internal" href="../overrides/"><span class="std std-doc">overrides</span></a>, <a class="reference internal" href="../qa/"><span class="std std-doc">residual QA</span></a>, and <a class="reference internal" href="../reproducibility/"><span class="std std-doc">reproducibility</span></a> for the policy and QA APIs.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
